name: structa-cloud
description: Nx orchestration layer for the Structa Cloud JavaScript monorepo

scripts.install:projects: npm run install:frontends && npm run install:formints
scripts.install:frontends: npm --prefix projects/precis/precis-landing/frontend install && npm --prefix projects/loop-crm/frontend install && npm --prefix projects/precis/precis-main/frontend install
scripts.install:formints: npm --prefix projects/formints/formint-cloud/frontend install && npm --prefix projects/formints/formint-standard install
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run test
